notes: Added complete story set for FEAT-4 Provider Detail Lookup.

change_log.value: Schema and contract for provider detail lookup
Facade/API integration for provider detail lookup
Unit and integration tests for provider detail service

FEAT-4-STORY-1.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
FEAT-4-STORY-1.description: Define Pydantic models and response contract for provider detail lookup including NPI data fields and external links.

FEAT-4-STORY-2.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup Logic
FEAT-4-STORY-2.description: Implement core service logic to query CMS NPI Registry API and normalize provider details including name, specialty, address, and identifiers.

FEAT-4-STORY-3.title: Expose Provider Detail via EvaluateCare Facade
FEAT-4-STORY-3.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into EvaluateCare facade and tool routing to enable agent access via tool calls.

FEAT-4-STORY-4.title: Construct and Validate External Provider Links
FEAT-4-STORY-4.description: Generate state medical board links and research URLs based on provider data and validate URLs using existing URL validation utilities.

FEAT-4-STORY-5.title: Test Provider Detail Lookup Service
FEAT-4-STORY-5.description: Create unit and integration tests for NPI lookup, data normalization, facade integration, and external link generation.
